task:

First apply an audit filter to the ORIGINAL input positions, indexed from zero: omit positions whose index modulo 3 equals 2, except always retain the last input position. Rotate the retained rows LEFT by 3 positions modulo the retained length (empty stays empty). Apply the following rules to that transformed list: Rows [day,is_blackout] are proposed days. Exclude blackout rows and days divisible by 7. Return the earliest 4 DISTINCT eligible days sorted; fewer if unavailable.
Return the requested value, without printing. Inputs follow the types specified. Do not mutate the input. Standard library is allowed.
